recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore ImagingManifest or edit its out-of-build spreadsheet for this issue; handle future frame-selection changes through active ImagingSelection work unless the work group explicitly reopens the removed ImagingManifest design.
issue_request: FHIR-13145 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Imaging Integration issue asking to add instance-level frameNumbers to ImagingManifest as unsignedInt with cardinality 0..n so selected frames in multi-frame DICOM objects could be referenced.
initial_application: Commit 9fa95b1d5035610e18cc3c571d60d84fd32c8f46 applied the issue by adding frame numbers to the ImagingManifest spreadsheet source. The retained source still contains ImagingManifest.study.series.instance.frameNumber with cardinality 0..*, type unsignedInt, and DICOM mapping (0008,1160).
additional_context: FHIR-14080 later removed ImagingManifest from active FHIR-core resources and is already represented on the combined branch by 915412ef84817e407d3aaf194fbdc9fbc12d9447. Current fhir.ini excludes ImagingManifest from active resources and lists it under removed resources, while history.html records it as deleted/removed. FHIR-17183 later created ImagingSelection, already represented by 004bef4da38b52b7bbc2650204a6cca61f58bc29, and current ImagingSelection includes instance.frameNumber support and notes/examples for multiframe selections.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing the retired ImagingManifest spreadsheet or adding duplicate current prose would not change current specification behavior because the historical fix is present and the active resource model is ImagingSelection.
